scope: Third search, Uttar Pradesh only: non-party organisations that helped electors during the 2025-26 SIR. Nothing in orgs.json or orgs2.json is repeated. Every quote was checked on 2026-10-13 against the page fetched from source_url (Dainik Bhaskar and The Times of India pages through Firecrawl; the APCR report as the PDF itself).

organisations.name: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, Muzaffarnagar district unit
organisations.what: Ran SIR help camps at 22 places in Muzaffarnagar district during enumeration, including one at a madrasa in Sadar tehsil, where people were helped to fill their enumeration forms. The unit said it had trained 544 young volunteers to fill the forms. A later report put the number of camps at 35, open to everyone whatever their religion.
organisations.quote: जमीयत उलेमा ने मुजफ्फरनगर जिले में 22 स्थानों पर शिविर लगाकर आम जनता को SIR फॉर्म भरने में सहायता प्रदान की है।
organisations.notes: Second source: The Times of India, 2025-11-25, quoting the unit's president that 35 camps were operational in the district and that 'All 14 units of Muzaffarnagar are fully engaged in this service'. A third Dainik Bhaskar report (2025-11-24, https://www.bhaskar.com/local/uttar-pradesh/muzaffarnagar/news/chaos-in-sir-form-process-in-muzaffarnagar-136500798.html) says 'जमीयत उलेमा-ए-हिंद ने स्थिति को देखते हुए जिले में 22 कैंप स्थापित किए हैं, जहां 400 से अधिक विशेषज्ञ लोगों को SIR फॉर्म भरने में सहायता प्रदान कर रहे हैं।' The counts differ between reports (22 or 35 camps, 544 trained or 400 helpers). The same unit also asked for the deadline to be extended by three months, which is advocacy beside the help. A religious organisation, not a party; no source names a party office-holder leading the unit. Which of the two Jamiat factions the unit belongs to is not stated. Every source quote names private people; the quotes chosen here do not.

organisations.name: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, Afzalgarh unit (Bijnor district)
organisations.what: Held an eight-day camp near the Jama Masjid in Afzalgarh town, Bijnor district, to fill and submit enumeration forms. On the fourth day its volunteers handed about 157 forms to the BLO. The unit also ran an awareness drive for the town's residents.
organisations.quote: जमीयत उलेमा-ए-हिंद ने जामा मस्जिद के पास लगाए शिविर में 157 फॉर्म जमा कराए
organisations.notes: The quote is the article's headline as printed on the page. This is a different town from the Bijnor camps in orgs2.json left_out (Sherkot, Nagina, Dhampur, Najibabad), and unlike that report it names the organisation. The body names the people who led the camp, all private persons; none is described as a party office-holder. A local Hindi report only.

organisations.name: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, Aligarh district unit
organisations.what: Ran three SIR help centres in Aligarh city during enumeration and asked educated young people to volunteer. The district president said the unit had been helping people for two weeks by late November 2025.
organisations.quote: Three help centres are operational in Aligarh city.
organisations.notes: WEAK: two sentences in a report mostly about Muzaffarnagar, resting on what the district president told the paper. No second source found. The same report says the Agra unit was 'conducting door-to-door awareness drives', which is awareness only and is listed under left_out.

organisations.name: Association for Protection of Civil Rights (APCR)
organisations.what: Ran a call centre from 4 to 30 November 2025, with SPECT, that guided callers on SIR forms, documents, missing names and corrections. It also held camps in Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Uttarakhand where volunteers helped people fill forms and checked their documents.
organisations.quote: Simultaneously, APCR organised awareness camps in Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, and Uttarakhand. Volunteers assisted with form filling, document review, and clarifications.
organisations.notes: SELF-REPORTED: the only source is the organisation's own annual report, which names no UP district and gives no UP numbers; page 59 carries a photograph captioned Uttar Pradesh. The report calls the SIR 'Special Identification and Registration', which is wrong; the quote avoids that sentence. Contact details are as printed on the report's back cover. The call centre was national and run from Delhi. APCR is a civil rights and legal aid organisation, not a party. If the owner requires an independent source, set publish to false.

excluded_parties.name: BJP Minority Morcha (Gorakhpur region office-holder's team), SIR camp in Ghosi, Mau
Samajwadi Party leader's SIR camp in Charthawal, Muzaffarnagar (headline only, not opened)
BJP mandal president's SIR form camp in Sohawal, Ayodhya (headline only, not opened)
Samajwadi Party workers' SIR camp in Jani Khurd, Meerut (snippet only, not opened)

not_found: No source found showing help with notices, hearings, Form 6 claims or appeals in Uttar Pradesh by any named non-party organisation (January to March 2026). Searches covered CJP, PUCL, Jamaat-e-Islami Hind, Khabar Lahariya, Gaon Connection, gurdwara committees, the UP State Legal Services Authority and district legal services authorities, in English, Hindi and Urdu.
UP State Legal Services Authority and DLSAs: no SIR help desk in Uttar Pradesh found. The Supreme Court's legal aid direction found in searches concerns Bihar.
Jamaat-e-Islami Hind: a Facebook post says it held SIR readiness camps, but no page found placing any of them in Uttar Pradesh.

left_out.name: Social workers in Bhaluani nagar panchayat, Deoria
left_out.why: Dainik Bhaskar (2025-11-24) shows camps where forms were filled in two wards, but the helpers are named individuals with no organisation.

left_out.name: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, Agra unit
left_out.why: The report says only that the unit was conducting door-to-door awareness drives. No help with forms is shown.

left_out.name: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, Deoband project
left_out.why: A search snippet of a Facebook video claims the Jamiat team in Deoband filled 8,650 forms. The page was not opened and no news report was found.

left_out.name: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind, statewide instruction to set up camps
left_out.why: The national general secretary's announcement is a plan. Only the district units shown delivering help are listed as organisations.
